children: rose 1.06% intraday after Bloomberg reported that the company plans about 38 gigawatts of data center capacity by 2032, more than triple its current footprint, citing people familiar with the matter.

Only about 2 gigawatts of Microsoft's current 12 are centered on AI-specific chips. That share is expected to reach roughly a third of the 38 gigawatts, which would put AI silicon near 13 gigawatts by 2032.

Microsoft expects $50 billion of capital expenditure in the fiscal first quarter of 2027 and $175 billion for calendar 2026. It is also planning to spread long-term data center leases over 25 years rather than 15, which lowers the annual capital expenditure it reports. The building and the cost stay the same. Only the annual reporting changes. In July the company forecast stronger than expected cloud growth, which eased concerns that infrastructure spending was running ahead of demand.

title: Microsoft Plans to Triple Its Data Center Footprint
